messages:
maria: Heads-up — found partner webhook logs writing a Vault-wrapped payload into partner-raw-logs. Partner kept the object; they say they don't have unwrap rights but we need containment and rotation ASAP. secbot saw a spike in failed unwrap attempts ~15m ago.

devin: Can you paste a redacted log line + object path? need to confirm wrapped vs plaintext. :eyes:

maria: redacted snippet:
```
2026-03-23T18:12:09Z INFO ingest: payload=\"vault:v1:wrapped:eyJhbGci...\" source=partner-webhook id=abc123
```
path: gs://partner-raw-logs/2026-03-23/partner-webhook/obj_abc123.json

alex: That looks like Vault transit wrapped ciphertext (not plaintext). Still treat as sensitive. Immediate: revoke any one-time unwrap tokens and start key/service-account rotations.

jordan_sre: Oncall pausing the ingest. Running: `gcloud pubsub subscriptions update ingest-pull --ack-deadline-seconds=600 --push-endpoint=disabled`. Will copy current objects to quarantine first.

secbot: automated-alert: vault-access-spike detected - 28 failed unwraps for key=transit/team-key between 18:00-18:15 UTC. Possible replay attempts.

olivia: For RBAC changes: propose a short-lived role `vault/transit-decrypter` limited by source IP and workload attestation. Grant only `partner-ingest-svcacc` for 24h during rotation. Also enable Vault audit sink to internal auditstore with 90d retention.

sam_platsec: Proposed checklist:
- contain: pause partner ingest + snapshot bucket -> gs://incident-quarantine/<id>
- assess: grep quarantine for any plaintext indicators (JWT, pkcs1, auth headers)
- revoke: rotate transit key `team-key` and revoke ephemeral unwrap tokens
- rotate: rotate partner-ingest-svcacc keys and any downstream service account keys; rotate DB creds if mapped
- audit: enable high-fidelity Vault audit for transit operations and push to SIEM; tag events with incident id
- RBAC: implement conditional constraints on decrypt/unwarp endpoints

devin: Example Vault commands we'll run:
```
vault write -force transit/keys/team-key/rotate
vault token revoke -prefix partner-unwrap-tokens-
```
Note: rotating transit key doesn't change existing wrapped ciphertext; for artifacts we control we can call `transit/rewrap` or request partner to rewrap after receiving new tokens.

alex: Check cross-wraps — some systems use GCP KMS wrapping with Vault-managed keys. Need inventory of cross-wrap relationships. @olivia to enumerate, @devin to run quick scan, @maria to coordinate partner.

maria: Partner confirms they only stored wrapped payloads and they never had unwrap privileges. They're deleting the retained objects and will cooperate.

jordan_sre: Pipeline paused and objects copied to `gs://incident-quarantine/1766666000/`. Permissions set read-only to sec team.

sam_platsec: Can secbot pull Vault audit events for key=team-key between 17:50-18:20 UTC? We need the list of accessors and client IPs.

secbot: query-result: 34 audit events found. sample: `2026-03-23T18:03:14Z auth.method=token path=transit/decrypt key=team-key accessor=... status=403`

devin: I'll create a temporary policy denying `transit/decrypt` for the partner service account until rotation completes. Plan to apply for 24h. Example policy:
```
policy "temp-deny-partner" {
  path "transit/decrypt" {
    capabilities = ["deny"]
  }
}
# bind to GCP SA
vault write auth/gcp/role/temp-deny bound_service_accounts=partner-ingest-svcacc policies=temp-deny-partner
```

olivia: Also enable GCP KMS audit forwarding for keys referenced by platform to the SIEM so we can correlate unwrap attempts. Add SIEM tag `incident=1766666000` across artifacts.

sam_platsec: Owners/action items:
- maria: partner coordination + file INC-1766666000, paste redacted logs, request deletion (ETA 30m)
- devin: apply temp deny policy + prepare rewrap playbook (ETA 2h)
- olivia: enumerate cross-wrap relationships + enable KMS audit forwarding (ETA 3h)
- jordan_sre: pipeline paused + quarantine copy (DONE)
- alex: enumerate downstream mappings (DBs, KMS uses) (ETA 1.5h)
- secteam: forensic scan of quarantine objects for plaintext artifacts (ETA 2h)

maria: Filing incident ticket now and CCing legal for contract/data-retention implications.

alex: Add postmortem checklist item to add webhook linter to block logging payloads that start with `vault:` or look like wrapped payloads. Could be a small devex rule.

devin: I'll open a PR for `deny_logging_sensitive_wrapped_payloads` lint in webhook templates and ping devex for rollout.

sam_platsec: We'll stand up a 45m check-in in #eng-security. If any further access anomalies show up, escalate to full incident. :lock:
